undo.day_off_cleared: Undo removing the day off on {date}

welcome.title: Welcome to Shift
welcome.body: Shift tracks your working time. Check in when you start, check out when you stop; your contract sets the daily target.

errors.command: Shift did not respond. Try again.
errors.undo_expired: This action can no longer be undone.

attention.suggest_checkin: It’s {time}, within your work hours. Start your shift?
attention.suggest_checkout: Your work hours are over. Check out?

rule_errors.one: {count} automation setting is invalid and ignored
rule_errors.other: {count} automation settings are invalid and ignored

attention.swayidle: Install swayidle to detect when you are away from the keyboard.
attention.holidays: Public holidays are unavailable: set your country in the settings, or check your connection.

reason.order: the end must be after the start
reason.range: the range ends before it starts

weekly_hours.label: Weekly hours
weekly_hours.description: Contract hours per week, split evenly over your workdays.

work_week.label: Work week
work_week.description: Days your contract expects you to work.

day_start_hour.label: Workday starts at
day_start_hour.description: Hour (0–12) at which a new workday begins. Work before it counts toward the previous day.

style.label: Style
style.description: What the widget shows next to today's time.

when_off.label: When checked out
when_off.description: Hidden widgets come back at the next check-in; check in from the panel, the control center or IPC.

automation.label: Automation
automation.description: Manual: you check in and out yourself. Assisted: Shift suggests check-ins and asks about absences. Automatic: Shift checks you in and out within your work hours.

window_start.label: Work hours start
window_start.description: HH:MM. Automation acts only within your work hours, on your workdays.

window_exclude_holidays.label: Not on public holidays
window_exclude_holidays.description: Public holidays are outside your work hours.

auto_checkin.label: Check in
auto_checkin.description: When you start using your computer within your work hours.

auto_checkout.label: Check out
auto_checkout.description: When your work hours end. Sessions started outside them are left alone.

idle_action.label: When inactive
idle_action.description: What to do when you have been away from the keyboard.

lock_action.label: When the screen is locked
lock_action.description: What to do with the time the screen stayed locked.

sleep_action.label: When asleep or offline
sleep_action.description: What to do with the time the computer slept, or Shift was not running.

idle_timeout_min.label: Inactive after (minutes)
idle_timeout_min.description: Minutes without keyboard or mouse input before you count as away.

min_absence_min.label: Shortest absence (minutes)
min_absence_min.description: Shorter breaks count as work and are not recorded.

unresolved_absence.label: Unreviewed absences
unresolved_absence.description: What happens at the end of the day to absences you did not review.

idle_backend.label: Idle detection
idle_backend.description: Auto uses swayidle when installed. External expects "signal idle" and "signal active" over IPC.

holidays_enabled.label: Public holidays
holidays_enabled.description: No target on public holidays, and no automatic check-in. Fetched from date.nager.at, the plugin's only network access.

holiday_country.label: Holiday country
holiday_country.description: Two-letter country code, such as FR or DE. Empty: from your locale.

holiday_region.label: Holiday region
holiday_region.description: Optional subdivision code for regional holidays, such as FR-67 or DE-BY.

command.title: Shift did not respond
command.body: Your action did not reach the Shift service. Try again, or disable and re-enable the plugin.

overlap.title: Session not recorded
overlap.body: It overlaps a session that is already recorded, probably because the system clock changed.

unavailable.title: Shift cannot save data
unavailable.body: The plugin data folder is unavailable ({file}). Tracked time will not be saved.

unreadable.title: Shift data is unreadable
unreadable.body: {file} exists but cannot be read. Shift will not save anything until this is fixed.

corrupt.title: Shift data was damaged
corrupt.body: {file} could not be parsed and was renamed with a .corrupt suffix. Shift continues without its contents.

corrupt_stuck.title: Shift data was damaged
corrupt_stuck.body: {file} could not be parsed nor renamed. Shift will not save anything until it is repaired or removed.

newer.title: Shift data is from a newer version
newer.body: {file} was written by a newer version of Shift. Update the plugin; nothing will be saved until then.

write.title: Shift could not save data
write.body: Writing {file} failed. Recent changes may be lost if Noctalia stops.
